original: Visit Cornwall recommends considering St Erth Park & Ride when town car parks are busy in summer. For Tate St Ives and other attractions, verify current opening and admission requirements directly; these excerpts do not establish availability or reservation rules.
translated: Visit Cornwall empfiehlt, den St. Erth Park & Ride in Betracht zu ziehen, wenn die Parkplätze im Sommer voll sind.
